description: Add a document to a notebook: plain text, or a file (PDF, Word, a spreadsheet, an image or audio) as base64. It is processed in the background (audio is transcribed); list_knowledge_documents shows when it is ready. The same file twice is recognised.

app_id.description: Optional app whose notebooks to use. Omitted: the owner's own Business Brain.

name: add_knowledge_document
title: Add Knowledge Document
